scope: Concrete finite-ring program correctness and actual point relation for four fixed lifts; no genericp-adictransfer,wholecurvepointcount,nativeexecutionrefinement,securitycostorbenchmark claim.
statement: Lean proves that each of four fixed public-input finite-ring Smart arithmetic attempts on the explicit160-bit fixture returns a scalar belowp satisfying the actual Mathlib relation dG=Q. It binds the public coordinates, exact prime order ofG, nonsingularity and binary schedule.
